functional_endpoint: JAr spheroid adhesion to AN3CA; murine implantation; biochemical binding

functional_endpoint: Apical CDH1 blocking; BAP-EB attachment; AFM

functional_endpoint: Mouse embryo adhesion to endometrial carcinoma lines

functional_endpoint: Forced nuclear actin disassembly, XPO6 overexpression perturb decid

functional_endpoint: Human endometrial organoid-conditioned medium inhibits stromal markers and MET

functional_endpoint: Recombinant IGFBP1 induction and alpha5beta1 antibody/RGD inhibition

proposed_signed_rule: S_PANX1 -> extracellular_ATP; decidual response has optimum PANX1/eATP level

caveat: Simple Boolean PANX1 positive or negative sign is contradicted by same paper; use level or stage model.

functional_endpoint: Human stromal NNMT siRNA and GSK126 rescue, mouse implantation
caveat: Abstract-only access; precise PRC2 causal chain and promoter specificity require figure check.

functional_endpoint: Human stromal SETD7 OE and pharmacologic FOXO1 phosphorylation inhibition

functional_endpoint: Desmoglein-2 blocking slows trophoblast transepithelial invasion
caveat: Endpoint invasion after attachment, not initial adhesion; full paper inaccessible on current route.

functional_endpoint: Rictor knockout mouse plus patient decidua and cell rescue
